research_question: Under repaired subject-independent validation, does native 200-Hz RCG add transferable continuous-ECG morphology information beyond a capacity-matched WSST-only model?
status: REGISTERED DESIGN ONLY; implementation, tests, code commit, smoke, and preflight required before launch
historical_constraint: The earlier B2b pilot was protocol-invalid because its three folds contained only two distinct repeated validation subjects. Its negative result motivates caution but cannot decide this gate. The later raw-RCG timing gate reduced some signed bias without improving precision or detection; native RCG information remains unproven.

protocol.seed_rule: base seed 42 plus fold; paired across arms
protocol.budget: max_epochs 80; patience 20; AdamW lr 1e-4, weight_decay 1e-4; batch 16
protocol.checkpoint: same locked validation composite for both arms; Shape-200 excluded
protocol.input_support: full-window _wsst8s.h5; native rcg from matching base H5; legacy 4-second WSST prohibited

arms.C0_capacity_matched_wsst: CENet B2a-wide with locked L3 MR-STFT waveform objective; WSST only
arms.C1_native_rcg_dual_stream: CENet B2b with the identical decoder and locked L3 MR-STFT objective; WSST plus native 50x1600 RCG

single_changed_variable: Presence of the native-rate RCG stem/input. B2a-wide widens only the internal WSST stem to match B2b capacity while preserving the same 128-channel stem output and all downstream tensors.

capacity_rule.known_counts: B2a-wide 1,487,551 versus B2b 1,487,667 trainable parameters; delta 116 (0.008%)
capacity_rule.preflight: Recompute counts from current code and require relative delta <=0.1%. Require byte-identical decoder state-dict shapes and configuration across arms.

locked_loss.waveform_core: 0.50 MR-STFT with FFT/window sizes 128/256/512 and hops 32/64/128
locked_loss.prohibited: No PCC or derivative addition, no weight tuning, no window tuning, and no fusion variant within this gate

input_guards: RCG uses all 50 native channels; no ECG-correlation or test-derived range-bin selection
RCG and WSST window identities/counts must match exactly
validation file hashes must be recorded and distinct across folds

decision_rule.waveform: C1-C0 PCC is positive on 3/3 folds with fold-macro delta >=0.05, and R2 improves on 3/3 folds.
decision_rule.mechanism: QRS-region MAE decreases on 3/3 folds and at least one of variance ratio or above-10-Hz energy ratio moves closer to 1 on 3/3 folds.
decision_rule.event_safety: Fold-macro F1@100 decline is <=0.02 and no individual fold decline exceeds 0.05.
decision_rule.promote: All waveform, mechanism, and event_safety requirements pass.
decision_rule.close: If any requirement fails, close native-RCG dual-stream scaling; do not tune fusion variants after observing this gate.

interpretation_limits: A win shows useful incremental information under this preprocessing and architecture; it does not prove direct recovery of myocardial electrical activity.
A failure bounds this tested direct-fusion route; do not overclaim a universal physical impossibility of radar sensing.
Variance-ratio 0.6-0.8 and any PCC target are validation objectives only, not expected or promised outcomes.
